messages:
Maya: quick note — SLO alerts in Console for tenant fallback routing blew up this morning, lots of duplicates across tenant + route. proposal below. :eyes:
Ajay: how noisy are we talking? screenshots?
Maya: ~120 noisy notifications in 30m; same incident duplicated across 3 routing tiers (primary, fallback, regional). stack traces are identical, just different tags. attaching example: `slo:latency_p95`, burn_rate spike.
Samir: agreed this is a known UX problem. I think we should add a suppression/aggregation step in the notify pipeline: collapse alerts with same root signal + overlapping window, then expand into per-tenant summaries. keeps pages low.
Tina: UX ask — when we collapse, console must still show which tenants were affected (not just counts). otherwise customers see nothing. maybe a collapsible list per alert card.
Ajay: operationally we need distinct escalation thresholds. suggestion: page for burn_rate > 2x sustained 5m, warn for >1.2x 10m, and a soft notify for >1.05x 30m that only goes to Slack channel (no pager). thoughts?
Samir: sounds reasonable. here's a draft rule we can encode in notify service (pseudo):
```
{
  "signal": "error_budget_burn_rate",
  "tiers": [
    {"name":"page","threshold":2.0,"window":"5m","targets":["oncall"]},
    {"name":"warn","threshold":1.2,"window":"10m","targets":["#eng-slo-warnings"]},
    {"name":"soft","threshold":1.05,"window":"30m","targets":["#eng-platform-notify"]}
  ]
}
```
Tina: also need an opt-out per-tenant (legal/compliance or enterprise customers want raw alerts). make it a tenant flag in Console (SLO -> alerts).
Maya: agreed. add toggle + ability to pin a tenant to always escalate.
Ajay: for routing fallbacks specifically, we should treat fallback-model alerts as lower priority unless primary also failing. i.e., if primary latency is fine but fallback is spiking, don't page. that will cut noise a lot.
Samir: implementation note — detect parent/child relationships by `route_group` tag and only escalate when parent or majority of siblings fire. simple quorum logic: if >50% of routes in a group cross page threshold, page.
Maya: QA question: will suppression increase time-to-detect for real incidents? we should run a 2-week canary with thresholds conservative, and measure mean time to detect.
Tina: +1 on canary. console should surface a small experiment card with the evaluation metrics (MTTD, false positives) for any alert config change.
ops-bot: deploybot: notify-pipeline v2 rolled out to staging at 1802345701. monitor logs at https://internal.redwood/ops/logs?svc=notify-pipeline
Ajay: ok let's run v2 in staging with the collapse rule and quorum logic. can we also add a dry-run mode that posts collapsed alerts to a #channel without paging?
Samir: yes — dry-run exists, will wire it to #eng-slo-dryrun.
Maya: action items: Samir -> land collapse + quorum PR, Tina -> mockups for collapsed alert card, Ajay -> run staging dry-run, Maya -> schedule 2-week canary and MTTD evaluation.
Tina: added to my board.
Samir: will open PR and tag @Maya for review. :thumbsup:
Maya: thanks team. will follow up with canary schedule.
